summary: Acer 16 Predator Neo, experiencing thermal throttling under load, causing CPU boosts above 3GHz, resulting in FPS drops, stuttering, and screen glitches. The issue persists despite multiple motherboard replacements and software resets.
detected_fault: EC/power telemetry throttling issue or unit-level defect
suggested_solution: Full replacement or credit for another model to ensure continued usage without disruptions
